How it works

Measure what can be measured.

Zelko follows one loop: assess → act → prove. Photo quality gates everything. Every score ships with confidence and the observed signal — never a black-box vibe check.

The loop

Assess

Upload photos. We extract 468 face landmarks client-side, then score measurable features with structured vision output.

Act

Recommendations unlock with weak scores — ranked by effort and confidence. You always know what to try next.

Prove

Paid tracking re-checks lighting and angle before comparing. Non-improvement is framed as no significant change — never a decline callout.

Scoring rubric

Eight features. Each with a signal and a confidence tier.

Face symmetry

Landmark mirror-pair deviation

High

Facial proportions

Landmark ratio vs classical thirds/fifths

Medium

Skin clarity

Texture/tone uniformity, pixel-level

Medium-high

Jawline definition

Edge contrast along jaw contour

Medium

Eyebrow shape

Arch, thickness, symmetry from landmarks

Medium-high

Eye spacing

Canthal tilt, inter-eye ratio

High

Grooming signal

Vision-model qualitative read

Low-medium

Photo quality

Lighting, blur, resolution, angle — gates the pipeline

High

Explicitly excluded

What we will never score.

  • Confidence / trustworthiness / intelligence
  • Approachability or other psychological inferences
  • Raw attractiveness as a single inferred number
  • Ethnicity-based comparison
  • Displayed age estimation
  • Health diagnoses
